title: RF Rule Object (Gate B authoring scaffold)
$comment: NON-EXECUTABLE structural schema for future Gate B machine-readable Rectus Femoris (RF) rule objects. It documents SHAPE, PROVENANCE, STATUS DISCIPLINE, and PROHIBITED-FIELD patterns only. It does NOT validate clinical correctness, and authoring a conformant object grants it no authority. During this development authoring phase, approval_status MUST NOT be 'approved'. The companion validator scripts/validate-rf-rule-package.mjs enforces these rules (some, like the prohibited-key patterns and the RF/QRF id formats, are enforced programmatically there because they exceed plain draft-07 expressiveness).

rule_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this authored rule object.

rule_family.description: Domain family, e.g. safety, diagnosis, rehabilitation, recurrence, field, readiness.

source_spec_rule_id.description: The RF v1.2 rule ID this object implements, e.g. RF-SAF-001.

approval_status.description: Lifecycle status. 'approved' is intentionally NOT permitted during this development authoring phase.

permitted_use.description: The strongest role the rule may play (mirrors RF v1.2 §4.2).

architecture_refs.description: List of V3.1 architecture references, e.g. V3.1-7, V3.1-21. May be empty for clinical-content-only rules (v1.2 §4.3); provenance is satisfied as long as at least one of architecture_refs or evidence_claim_ids is non-empty (enforced by the validator).

evidence_claim_ids.description: QRF evidence-claim IDs, each preserving its individual grade. May be empty for architecture-only rules (V3.1 §4.3).

input_contract.description: Structural placeholder for required inputs. No clinical content in this phase.

decision_contract.description: Structural placeholder for the decision. No executable decision logic in this phase.

safety_state_output.description: One of the closed V3.1 §21 safety states, or null when not a safety rule.

blocked_targets.description: Targets blocked by this rule's safety output.

prohibited_outputs.description: Prohibited inferences this rule must never emit.

test_fixtures.description: IDs of positive/negative/adversarial fixtures for this rule.

executable.description: If present, MUST be false. No rule object is executable in this phase.

x_prohibited_patterns.$comment: Documented prohibitions enforced programmatically by the validator (deep key scan, case-insensitive). Listed here for authoring guidance only.
